description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Akeneo is hiring a Software Engineer for its Customer Engineering & Quality team. The role investigates and resolves customer issues, ships production-ready fixes, and improves the performance, reliability, observability, and cost-efficiency of the Akeneo Product Cloud.
Software Engineer improving PIM platform reliability through customer issue diagnosis, production fixes, observability, and incident response

Responsibilities:
• Investigate and resolve complex customer issues: Reproduce technical problems, trace evidence across application and infrastructure layers to find the root cause, and either ship a validated fix within our PIM scope or collaborate with the owning product team
• Drive proactive platform improvements: Turn customer feedback and production insights into lasting gains in system performance, reliability, observability, and cost-efficiency. Cutting recurring failures and manual work before they cause incidents
• Ship maintainable, production-ready code: Deliver fixes, tooling, and performance upgrades with built-in tests and clear documentation, safely validating every change in production
• Monitor systems and improve observability: Use logs, metrics, and dashboards to track service health, refine instrumentation, and reduce alert noise so real customer-impacting issues stand out
• Participate in collaborative incident response: Join a supported on-call rotation to triage alerts, assess customer impact using existing runbooks, safely mitigate production issues alongside senior engineers, and document learnings to prevent future occurrences

Requirements:
• Practical experience building maintainable software using strong development principles, automated testing, and data structures, with an eagerness to deepen your system design judgment
• Hands-on coding ability and willingness to work across TypeScript/React, PHP, and automation tooling
• A natural curiosity for how systems behave post-deployment, paired with the ability to test hypotheses, distinguish symptoms from root causes, and navigate ambiguous problems using data and evidence
• A thoughtful approach to safe deployments, rollbacks, and customer impact, combined with the ability to leverage modern AI coding tools (like Claude Code) to explore codebases and accelerate learning while maintaining strict data privacy and code ownership
• The ability to translate complex technical findings into clear updates for Product Support, cross-functional engineering teams, and teammates, while openly giving and receiving feedback

Preferred:
• experience with SQL, Linux, GCP, containers, or infrastructure-as-code is helpful
